Bamako – The World.

Your gateway to the world

ABS — African Business School

African ambition, international horizons.

In Bamako, ABS champions a vision of higher education that combines knowledge, practical skills, international openness and responsibility. Our ambition: to support students as they build their academic and professional projects, with particular attention to African realities and the transformations reshaping our world.

Explore our programmes Start my applicationConnect with ABS

Overview

Learn, practise, build your future

Choosing a programme means choosing a direction. At ABS, we want to help every student understand the challenges of their field, develop solid working methods and gradually turn their learning into applicable skills. Courses are designed to bring together fundamentals, case studies, projects and discovery of the professional world, according to the arrangements defined for each programme.

Why ABS?

An African university geared towards action.

Rigorous training, rooted in African realities and open to skills, professions and international challenges.

  • A pan-African ambition: learning from the realities of the continent and engaging in dialogue with the world.
  • Action-oriented teaching: case studies, projects, presentations and hands-on scenarios, depending on the course.
  • Transversal skills: communication, English, digital tools, personal development and teamwork.
  • A culture of responsibility: ethics, professionalism, respect and consideration for sustainable development issues.
  • A human-scale environment: close relationships that foster guidance, attentive listening and commitment.
Our vision and values

Sokhna Maryama Thiam

Director General

Our fields of study

Five fields, one standard of excellence.

View all programmes

ABS develops programmes in the fields of management, engineering, digital technology, international relations and communication. The list of programmes actually open for each intake is displayed and updated by the administration.

Management, finance, marketing, organisation, entrepreneurship and running business activities.
